title: Payment Failed Paper Trail
description: A declined card shouldn't just fail quietly at the billing layer — the customer needs to actually hear about it, both in-app and by email, and the failure reason should be traceable through to the notification body.
successCondition: Book a shipment, create an invoice, and pay it with cardNumber 4000000000000002 (guaranteed decline). After waiting past the notification queue delay, GET /api/notifications as that customer shows an entry with type "payment.failed" and a body mentioning the invoice id. GET /api/notifications/outbox as admin, filtered by the customer's email, shows a message with subject "Payment failed" whose body also references the decline.
hints: The exact card number and decline behavior are documented in docs/api/billing.md's mock gateway table.
Both the in-app notification and the mock email are enqueued from the same notify() call in the billing service — if one appears, the other should too, once you've waited past the queue delay.
